summary: Illumina filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, reporting that on October 8, 2026 it entered definitive documentation for a new unsecured commercial paper program of up to $1.0 billion, with three dealers and a national bank as issuing and paying agent. Notes may be issued at a discount or bear fixed/floating interest, maturities up to 397 days, proceeds for general corporate purposes; no notes outstanding at filing. This is a routine financing/credit facility arrangement, not a special situation. Watch funding mix and liquidity, not deal arbitrage.
